raw: The main purposes of this Act are— (a) to amend the Confiscation Act 1997 to improve the operation of that Act as it applies to serious and organised crime; and Victoria (b) to amend the Criminal Organisations Control Act 2012 to remove the distinction between different types of declarations made in respect of organisations; and (c) to make other miscellaneous amendments to the Surveillance Devices Act 1999, the Open Courts Act 2013, the Criminal Procedure Act 2009, the Sentencing Act 1991 and the Family Violence Protection Amendment Act 2014.
